fields.calculatedFormula:
if( isnull(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c),
/* Legacy calculation pre-CPQ */
(
Debit_Revenue__c +
Credit_Revenue__c +
Visa_Business_Debit_Revenue__c +
Other_Business_Cards_Revenue__c +
STF_Revenue__c +
MMSC_Revenue__c +
(12 *  Locations__c * (  Platform_fee__c  +  Premium_Support__c  )) +
(12 * Amount) +
Surcharge_Revenue__c
),
SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Gross_Revenue__c
)
